constraints.name: ck_session_lifecycle
constraints.definition: CHECK (((lifecycle_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'OPEN'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'PLAY_FINISHED'::character varying, 'SETTLED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))
